name: desktop-environments-cosmic-extensions
description: COSMIC's community extensions and panel applets: calculator, tweaks, cosmic-ctl, the weather, sysinfo, caffeine, brightness and privacy-indicator applets, and the fingerprint enrolment GUI.
optInReason: every one of these source builds. They are community cosmic-utils packages, in neither cache.nixos.org nor cosmic.cachix.org — expect a slow rebuild the first time you enable this bundle, not a hang
